data.name: Avantika
data.gender_notes: Avantika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avantika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘avanti’ which means 'desirable' or 'lovable'. The suffix ‘ka’ signifies a female form. The name is often associated with the goddess Avantika, who is considered the embodiment of pleasing and beautiful qualities. The name Avantika carries the meaning “Desirable, Lovable, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avantika usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, lovable, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Avantika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desirable, Lovable, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avantika total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Avantika is quite popular in the Hindi speaking world and is recognized as a beautiful and aesthetic name for a girl. Historically, Avantika was the name of a beautiful lake situated in the central Indian town of Bhopal. The lake was considered sacred as it was believed to possess divine and healing powers. The name thus is rooted in Indian culture and is often associated with grace, beauty, and divine femininity.
data.spiritual_significance: Avantika is also considered the name of a minor goddess in Hindu mythology. She is revered as the patron of learning and knowledge. The name is believed to bestow divine blessings and protect the bearer from all forms of worldly evils. It is a powerful name which emanates a sense of spiritual serenity and purity. It is said that those who bear this name possess inner courage and are constantly in search of truth and knowledge. Overall, the name Avantika signifies spiritual growth and development, and a deep connection to divine femininity and knowledge.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Avantika, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Avanti', symbolizes progress and advancement. It embodies the spirit of moving forward in life with courage and determination. The name is a reminder to embrace change and continue growing.

vedic_reference.note: Avantika is the name of a river in ancient India, mentioned in the Mahabharata.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Avantika was a queen of the Satavahana dynasty in the 1st century BCE. The name Avantika carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
